notes: Connect Facebook now works from the app itself -- until now it only worked from a browser, and the app window was the one place it failed. Also: a new Facebook app that lacks the insights permission no longer blocks the whole login, the app tells you straight away if you paste a User token instead of a Page token, the post-after-rendering checkbox works even if you connect the page afterwards, and a PC without WebView2 opens in the browser instead of showing nothing at all.
